title: Love Your Neighbour — The Eternal Perspective

main_kjv_passage.excerpt: 27. And he answering said, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy strength, and with all thy mind; and thy neighbour as thyself.

supporting_kjv_passages.excerpt: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD.

And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be ye warmed and filled; notwithstanding ye give them not those things which are needful to the body; what doth it profit? 17. Even so faith, if it hath not works, is dead, being alone.

Scripture must be more than a verse we admire and then forget. It searches the choices we make at home, at work and in the presence of strangers. Loving a neighbour is more demanding than approving of the idea of kindness. Jesus taught that a neighbour’s needs can interrupt our plans.
